findings.evidence: Diffractive/Basic.lean:55 `namespace ExclKinematics` with no `namespace Diffractive` anywhere (grep for `namespace Diffractive` in EpsilonEridani/: no matches); Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:66 `noncomputable def xiSkew (g : Bilin V) (K : ExclKinematics V) : ℝ`.
findings.fix: Either introduce the `Diffractive` namespace the description claims (`Diffractive.xi g K`, `Diffractive.beta`, `Diffractive.MX2`, `Diffractive.xBj_eq_xi_mul_beta`), matching the roadmap's own dedicated `Invariants` namespace, or qualify as `xiDiff`/`betaDiff` in the style of the already-qualified `xiSkew`. Roadmap Convention 1 only forbids `xPom`; neither option violates it.
findings.issue: `ExclKinematics.xi` claims the bare symbol ξ in a namespace that already has `ExclKinematics.xiSkew` (Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:66) — a different ξ for the same record. `K.xi` reads as the skewness that `ExclKinematics` was built for; the docstring disclaimer does not fix the interface. `beta` (line 86) and `MX2` (line 95) are likewise diffraction-only notions named generically on the general DVCS/DVMP record (for DVCS, `MX2` is the produced photon's mass squared). The PR description states these live in `namespace Diffractive`, but the file declares them directly in `namespace ExclKinematics`.

findings.evidence: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:81 `tMom_eq_hadronic_transfer_sq` and :87 `tMom_eq_photon_transfer_sq : K.tMom g = g (K.q - K.qPrime) (K.q - K.qPrime)` — identical statement shape, `_sq` suffix.
findings.fix: Rename to `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta_sq` and update the module docstring's Main results entry.
findings.issue: `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` names an equality whose RHS is `g (K.q - K.delta) (K.q - K.delta)`, i.e. the *square* of `q - delta`, not `q - delta` (which is a `V`, not an `ℝ`). The two existing lemmas of the same shape in the parent namespace carry `_sq`.

summary: Two naming defects: the diffractive variables are declared bare in `ExclKinematics`, where `xi` collides with the existing `xiSkew` on the same record (and the PR description's claimed `namespace Diffractive` does not exist in the code), and `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` drops the `_sq` that its two sibling lemmas in the same namespace carry.
